facts.fact: Altron Security completed a key milestone on Zambia's national PKI, built under a contract from ZICTA won three years earlier, announced 7 September 2026.

ZMB.note: Document says nothing on civil register and ID links.
No count of people holding a national ID for Zambia.
No ID number at birth stated.
Covers the PKI contract only, not who operates a national ID system.
No public register keyed on the ID number stated.
No national ID system in service or security certification stated for Zambia.
